name: kv_cache
description: KV cache in LLM serving, in two parts. (1) Sizing: bytes per token = 2 (K and V) x layers x KV heads x head_dim x dtype bytes; for DeepSeek-V3's Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) it is layers x (512 latent + 64 RoPE key) x dtype bytes. The learner picks a model preset (Llama-3.1 8B/70B/405B, Qwen3 32B, Qwen3 235B-A22B, Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek-V3), the attention variant (MHA / GQA / MQA, plus MLA for DeepSeek-V3; the model's real one is marked with a check, others are hypothetical), KV and weight dtypes, GPU, tensor-parallel degree, sequence length and batch. It shows KV per token / sequence / batch, a bar comparison of the variants, and one GPU's memory split into weights and KV with the usable limit, plus how many full-length sequences fit after weights. TP splits KV heads across GPUs but replicates them when TP > KV heads; the MLA latent is replicated on every TP rank. GPU memory is the vendor capacity in GiB (80 GB H100 = 80 GiB = 85.9e9 B) times mem_util (default 0.9, like vLLM). Activations and CUDA graphs are ignored. (2) Allocation: seeded random requests (current lengths skewed short, all starting with a shared system prompt) drawn as physical memory maps at the same scale: contiguous max-length preallocation (reserved but empty space faint) vs PagedAttention blocks handed out on demand from a pool (blocks of different requests interleave). Block size 8-128 tokens shows internal fragmentation; 'Share blocks' stores the system prompt's full blocks once (ref-counted; its partial last block is copied on write). Stats: tokens stored, contiguous waste %, paged internal fragmentation %, and how many such requests fit in the chosen GPU's free memory under each scheme. Good tasks: 'how much KV memory does GQA save over MHA for Llama-3.1 70B?', 'find the largest batch of 8K-token sequences that fits on 4x H100', 'why does DeepSeek-V3 need so little KV?', 'pick a block size and explain the fragmentation trade-off', 'how much does sharing a 1K-token system prompt save?'. Use view to show only one part. Reported state: model, attention, kv_heads, dtypes, gpu, tp, seq_len_tokens, batch, kv_bytes_per_token, kv_bytes_per_sequence, kv_bytes_for_batch, weights_gb_per_gpu, free_for_kv_gb_per_gpu, max_concurrent_sequences, batch_fits, requests, block_size_tokens, used_tokens, contiguous_waste_fraction, paged_internal_fragmentation_fraction, shared_prefix_blocks, requests_that_fit_contiguous, requests_that_fit_paged, verdict.

attention.description: Initial attention variant. MLA only exists for deepseek_v3; an unavailable choice falls back to the model's native variant.

weight_dtype.description: Weights dtype (determines memory left for KV).

tp.description: Tensor-parallel degree (GPUs sharing weights and KV).

seq_len.description: Tokens per sequence (rounded to a power of two).

batch.description: Concurrent sequences (rounded to a power of two).

mem_util.description: Fraction of GPU memory usable for weights + KV (not a learner control).

requests.description: Number of requests in the allocation view.

max_len.description: Max sequence length that contiguous allocation reserves per request.

prefix_tokens.description: Length of the system prompt every request starts with.

share_prefix.description: Start with prefix blocks shared (copy-on-write) instead of copied per request.
